conversation 7.text:
## Conversation 7 - Simplify design and improve performance

### User prompt

> Check if we can simply the design and make it more maintainable and improve performance. Apply parallelism where appropriate and needed. Update the respective tests, git actions, and copilot log files for module9.

### Assistant response

> Replaced the neural network's finite-difference gradient—which evaluated the loss twice per parameter—with a vectorized backpropagation gradient. The gradient is checked against a finite-difference reference in a unit test. The XOR workload is too small to benefit from parallel execution, so it remains serial rather than adding overhead; the reusable CI workflow now runs Python 3.12 and 3.13 as parallel matrix jobs. Payroll outputs are rounded consistently at each monetary step, and tests assert the resulting accounting invariants.
